newsitem.title: JORDAN: Jordan o/n rate hovers in wide 6.00-8.00 pct range.
newsitem.headline: Jordan o/n rate hovers in wide 6.00-8.00 pct range.

text.p: Jordan overnight dinar rates fluctuated in a wide 6.00-8.00 pct band on Thursday in generally minimal demand in the last working day before the Moslem Eid al Fitr holiday, dealers said.
Banks usually close their positions before the Eid al-Fitr holiday which officially starts on Saturday and banks will also be closed on Friday, which is the weekly holiday.
Dealers said most of the banks only resorted to minimal borrowing as customer cash demand rose sharply ahead of the holiday.
The Central Bank said on Wednesday the weighted average overnight interbank rates stood at 8.02 percent.
